title: Two elements, same local name, different namespaces
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

explanation.approach: The bare `.Status` selector matches `a:Status` simply because it is the first sibling in the document — not because it belongs to any particular namespace. `b:Status` is silently skipped.
